rows.text:
Independent subagent migration_plan_review — preliminary foundation findings (reproduced before correction):
- Aborted transactions reserved predicate identities; mutable predicates made cached and direct results disagree.
- Repeating an old unsubscribe removed a replacement subscription.
- Throwing observer-error handlers made committed transactions appear rejected.
These are implementation findings, not checkpoint approval.
